answer: Every identity rents one exclusive 20-meter map cell on a published topographic ridge and each epoch returns a signed snapshot whose shadow angle and weather hash match public stations for that cell at challenge time. Two keys naming one cell each forfeit a 60 POA bond, and a sable stamp marks both addresses on the public roll. Unique occupants settle on a velvet payout lane. Cell rent is about $18 a month, a design assumption not a surveyed price. A body cannot occupy two cells when the snapshot is due, so 180 fakes require 180 cells: about $3,240 monthly plus 10,800 POA locked.
